entities.name: Ashk Dahlén
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ashk Peter Dahlén is a Swedish scholar, linguist, Iranologist, translator, and associate professor (docent) in Persian language at Uppsala University. He is quadrilingual in Swedish, Persian, English, and French. He has published extensively in journals, and has written several books.

entities.summary: Ashk Peter Dahlén is a Swedish scholar, linguist, Iranologist, translator, and associate professor (docent) in Persian language at Uppsala University.
